investment_theses.thesis: Widespread infrastructure outages (NSA, banks, Apple) + 2027 recession warnings (Druckenmiller short copper) + de-escalating US-China tensions (Trump-Xi meeting) = compressed regulatory risk premium on Bitcoin and decentralized finance; long BTC/short SPY ratio outperformance over 90-180 days.

CoinDesk: Druckenmiller short copper, warns 2027 economic weakness
CNBC: Xi calls for removing trade/investment barriers, trilateral Trump-Xi-Putin summit
Hacker News: classified US national security network down (systemic fragility narrative)
investment_theses.counter_view: Outages may be one-off; Druckenmiller's 2027 call is speculative and cyclical recoveries have surprised bears historically; Trump-Xi rapprochement stalls if geopolitical tensions re-escalate (Crimea bridge attack, Ukraine proxy war persistence).
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC spot or perpetual futures, hedge with short SPY or QQQ; express as BTC/SPY ratio or BTC perps with 10-15x leverage on 60-day target
